'''Rad al'Dai''' is a [[Two Rivers]] man in the army led by [[Perrin Aybara]].

== Activities ==
He participates in the [[Battle of Dumai's Wells]] and carries the Red Wolfhead banner back to [[Cairhien]] when they [[Traveling|Travel]] back there.{{ref/book|7|2}}
